queries.result: First-party discovery found the Namakkal District Administration land-record service, which directs users to Tamil Nadu e-Services for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, patta verification, and poramboke verification. Tamil Nadu TNGIS was also found as a state GIS portal with a district.namakkal entry, but no public parcel-vector response was verified.
